implementation: At compact widths, keep the legend text visually clipped instead of display:none, preserving its browser accessible name with unchanged visual footprint.
Put active business-button feedback after hover so actual mouse-down has a distinct settled background.

Read the actual browser accessibility tree across 17 map surfaces per role/viewport; test names, selected/expanded/disabled semantics, loading/error text, role-specific maintenance, two-column actions and settled pointer/keyboard feedback. Existing audit and one-shot photo-failure checks remain intact.

finalIntegratedFollowup.scope: Final integration includes the observational asynchronous-content helper. Application build unchanged.

scriptCorrections: Initial project/list area selectors were corrected to the actual accessible names. These incomplete attempts are not counted as passes.
Initial color samples caught ongoing transitions. Final assertions wait for a stable color before comparing normal/hover/active; this exposed the genuine hover override and required a CSS fix.
limits: Isolated roles and fixtures; no production account/permission write or switch claim.
Browser accessibility tree is not VoiceOver/TalkBack output. Physical touch/keyboard/OS toolbar checks retain their own incomplete items.
Representative shared button variants and map work surfaces are covered, not every unrelated site route.
